implementation_under_test: Current source login using real local Django auth options: guest disabled, registration enabled.

user_simulator.task: Reach a usable account entry without entering personal information.
user_simulator.result: Registration path was visible and reached; no personal data was entered and no Agent prompt was submitted.
user_simulator.reason: The simulator inspected registration, then returned to login; it did not create an account or reach the authenticated app.

critic_findings_and_fixes.finding: Auth tabs were mouse-oriented without arrow-key navigation or roving focus.
critic_findings_and_fixes.fix: Implemented tab semantics, roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, Home/End.

critic_findings_and_fixes.finding: If the options endpoint failed, registration was hidden even if the server might allow it.
critic_findings_and_fixes.fix: Keep login and registration available on options failure, hide guest, explain uncertainty, and provide retry.

critic_findings_and_fixes.finding: A retry did not restore useful focus and its touch target was undersized.
critic_findings_and_fixes.fix: Focus the account panel on successful retry and size retry target to at least 44x44 CSS px.
critic_findings_and_fixes.retest: focus, status announcement, and bounding box verified

critic_findings_and_fixes.finding: Initial loading changed the available tab layout.
critic_findings_and_fixes.fix: Added explicit loading status while the authoritative options are read.

regression.auth_options_failure: guest hidden, login and registration available, retry announced
regression.keyboard_tabs: ArrowLeft/Right and Home/End pass; selected tab receives roving focus
regression.mobile_320px: no horizontal overflow; retry target at least 44x44 CSS px

remaining_gap: The holdout request for a no-account demonstration is still impossible while backend guest access is disabled. Do not bypass the backend setting in the browser.
